title: I’m in Love with the Villainess!
description: I am in Love with the VillainessOrdinary office worker Ohashi Rei wakes up in the body of the protagonist of her favorite otome game, Revolution. To her delight, the first person to greet her is also her favorite character, Claire Francois—the main antagonist of the story! Now, Rei is determined to romance Claire instead of the game’s male leads. But how will her villainous ladylove react to this new courtship?!

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Overworked employee Oohashi Rei suddenly finds herself in the world of her favorite otome game as its protagonist, Rae Taylor. But she's not here to romance the game's male leads - she's in love with the villainess!

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Rae sets her sights on her dream job as Claire's maid - and she'll do whatever it takes to get it.

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Realizing that Claire is in love with Thane, Rae tries to direct events she recognizes from the game toward getting Thane and Claire together, despite her own feelings for Claire.

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Rae impresses her teacher and classmates at the academy with her proficiency in magic... and is quickly forced to put her skills into practice when a huge monster attacks.

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Rae and Claire both pass the written exam for entry into the Academy Knights. The next step is the practical exam, which pits the examinees against each other in mock battles to determine who is truly worthy to join the Knights.

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The Foundation Day Fair is coming up, and the Academy Knights discuss what sort of shop they should open. An offhanded comment by Rae leads to the proposal of a cross-dressing café.

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Rae makes the most of the Foundation Day Fair, working hard at the cross-dressing café and even convincing Claire to walk around the fair with her. But an incident with a group of bitter commoners casts a shadow over the festive atmosphere...

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The Royal Academy is rocked by scandal when a noble student allegedly attacks a commoner student with magic. The situation escalates when the attacker receives minimal punishment, spurring commoners to protest so violently that the school must be closed.

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: As a darker plot is revealed behind the commoner uprising, the academy is plunged into peril. Can Rae and Claire defeat the conspirators and deal with the resulting aftermath?

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Princess Manaria of the Sousse Kingdom, an old childhood friend of Claire's, shows up to visit her. Manaria has it all—good looks, charisma, tremendous magic proficiency—and to top it off, Claire is quite taken with her. It seems Rae has a new rival...

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Rae insists she just wants Claire to be happy, even if she can't be with her. Manaria tells her she's just running away, and if her feelings for Claire are true, she'll fight for her. So begins their duel to determine who will stay by Claire's side...

episodes_data.title: I’m in Love with the Villainess! Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Manaria challenges Rae to prove her feelings for Claire at the Amour Ceremony. Both Rae and Manaria must place an item on the Scales of Love, which will measure the weight of their feelings for Claire. Who will the scales find worthy?
